strongest_examples.mechanism: Optional fertilizer pickup delayed two three-sheep couriers while carrying wool; opponent delivered and sold before the price decline.
Existing sales left small covered product quantities until later, after opponents sold.

observations.unresolved: Several large defeats involve different production plans, crop diversity and earlier investment. The proposed changes do not establish a complete solution against private top agents.

changes.delivery: Prioritize wool collection and delivery over optional fertilizer gathering for the dynamic three-sheep couriers; preserve feeding, care and harvesting.
changes.sales: Fill only 1-8 residual covered units in an existing cash-product sale against highly similar farms; preserve order count and physical actions.
changes.status: Initial candidate rejected by its original nonmirror criterion; not deployed.

methodology.development: 128 complete games; candidate32/32, wool-only31points/32, Market1 25/32, Market2 27/32. Two development seeds only.
methodology.independent_holdout: Frozen beforehand: eight unseen seeds, both seats, ten opponents and two active controls, 480 games. Gates and source hashes in plan.json.
methodology.limits: Eight independent seed clusters, correlated public code families, no equivalence to leaderboard rating or a guaranteed silver medal.

discussions.use: Paired seeds, lineage-aware league and per-opponent reporting.
Separate frozen replays from reactive opponents; compare both active releases.
BC/PPO and win/loss objectives discussed; no RL implemented or claimed.
Shared randomness can diverge when planting actions change.
Official final evaluation discussion; ratings are not final placements.

grigor: Optional source search stopped after user said to forget it if unavailable. No victory against Grigor verified; eight downloaded fixtures retained as research only.

adaptive_followup.design: Economic guard on wool urgency versus retaining all old physical actions and only filling residual sales.
adaptive_followup.selection: Only one fully passing finalist, highest total points, then nonmirror points, then simpler fill-only policy.
adaptive_followup.status: Frozen before any fresh game; final results pending.
